Distinguish the retained physical runtime anchor from the C3 source-free runtime anchor. No install-on-import or silent dependency upgrade.
execution_surface_identifier_issuing_rul: An execution-surface identifier may be issued ONLY for a surface that (a) is not the user's Mac, (b) is reachable and reproducible, (c) satisfies or has a HQ-adjudicated resolution for the two hard runtime gates, and (d) has a complete frozen dependency inventory including pandas, pytest and duckdb. No surface meets these conditions. Therefore no identifier is issued, and none may be inferred from this packet.
